business_problem: Bell needed to replace a fragmented service experience spread across 26 applications and 8,800 data silos with one platform that could unify field operations, order management, customer self-service, and enterprise service delivery for millions of telecom customers.
solution_summary: Bell Canada is rebuilding customer and field operations on the ServiceNow AI Platform so service, sales, and delivery run on one telecommunications workflow backbone. Field Service Management for Telecommunications gives the 12,000-person field organization dispatch, route optimization, scheduling, escalations, and a service record for more than 10,000 daily tasks. Sales CRM for Telecommunications provides a CRM portal for 22 million customers and the lifecycle view that replaces 26 separate applications. AI-driven tools such as Virtual Repair and coaching reduce call load, while machine-learning job-duration predictions improve planning. Bell also uses Service Bridge within Telecommunications Service Management to connect Bell workflows with enterprise customers that already run ServiceNow, shortening new-product delivery and making cross-company collaboration native. The result is one platform that supports self-service, order management, field execution, and enterprise co-delivery.

data_flow: Customer and field-service data from thousands of silos is unified on the ServiceNow AI Platform, where Sales CRM for Telecommunications manages lifecycle interactions and Field Service Management for Telecommunications dispatches and schedules work. AI-powered self-service deflects calls, routing and job-duration predictions guide technicians, and Service Bridge exchanges workflow context with enterprise customers' ServiceNow environments for faster product launches and shared service delivery.
business_outcome: Bell Canada is automating 90% of dispatch-related tasks, deflects 3 million support calls annually, has saved more than 500,000 customer calls through AI-powered Virtual Repair, saved over $1 million a year on in-house support calls, and shortened enterprise product launches to MVPs in two weeks.
